decisions.title: Digest / manifest / stable target
decisions.selection: ProfileRef.digest = SHA-256 of pinned named Profile view excluding ref.digest (R03 KNOW and R02 PREP mapping); raw registry/value schema remain independently pinned. Hash exact Scope, normalized platform values, raw bytes; binding.v1 binds Scope hash and immutable manifest definition. Ordered assets; no input copy to readback. Candidate one operation per step; stable logical effect ID independent of profile version/registration. Persist pinned manifest snapshot with accept.
alternatives: step input only: submit steps empty
pending: per-platform step subdivision/effect unit; stable slot lineage and cross-source ambiguity
actual readback normalization and AssetRef mapping, explicit unordered field rules if warranted

decisions.title: Claim / lease / permit / fence
decisions.selection: CO atomic claim before I4 dispatch. Pass opaque internal claim capability through bridge, never serialize to I4 JSON/public. Runtime verifies exact live connection/generation/account and binds same claim. STORE checks state, owner, operation and stable effect; durable one-shot reserve/consume. No post-fence consume. After consume treat as potentially in-flight; serialize runtime command initiation with local fence gate, no await between gate decision and enqueue. DB and external side effect not atomic, no exactly-once claim. No takeover/resume; lost worker fences and stops.
pending: actual R03/R05 internal signature and concurrency test; process shutdown and live connection validity; actual dispatch fence race

decisions.title: Admission-linked evidence / snapshot finalize
decisions.selection: Persist immutable observations tied to admitted operation, worker/target and trusted evidence; duplicate identical ID idempotent, conflicting ID rejected. Result compare evidence version (CAS) and exact required steps/goal/unknown; stopped never reopens. Ordinary observation after terminal forbidden; optional separate scoped late read with its own authorization, never rebind/resubmit. No late-read implementation until proof.
alternatives: allow terminal lease bypass: evidence forgery
trust execution response: lost-response or mismatch
pending: trusted actual readback/evidence source; atomic terminal result/revision, late-read integration

decisions.title: Viewer / session security
decisions.selection: Same-origin service owner + single-use attach grant bound to owner/registration/generation/expiry. Exclusive input; grant rotate on refresh/reconnect; finish revokes input before verification; detach never cancels accepted worker. See SESSION-SECURITY.md. No URL/query grants, exported cookies/storage_state, frames/input logs.
pending: actual WS/WSS edge/auth/origin, IME, concurrent input cutoff, browser process/network sandbox, cleanup/retention, production identity

decisions.title: PREP deadline / revision
decisions.selection: Keep PrepareInput/Preparation sync Protocol; execute outside DB/ASGI loop, bounded call and generation/revision CAS. Late timeout output discarded; model unavailable => blocking issue, malformed schema => safe runtime error. Provider hard cancellation not assumed.
pending: actual model time/limits, R02/R03 bridge and errors

decisions.title: Composition / managed lifetime
decisions.selection: Explicit factories/injection; single app process initial mock, managed worker and runtime-owned async bridge. Startup fence orphaned accepted jobs, no replay. Shutdown admission stop, fence, bounded drain, close browser contexts and resources. Separate test identity and product identity.
pending: actual factory and launch, async bridge, shutdown; production authentication and operational isolation
